caption: The drawing consists of three detailed renderings of a single object, which appears to be a metal tool shaped somewhat like a pair of shears or clippers. The central part of the drawing, occupying the lower half, shows a three-dimensional, shaded perspective view of the object rendered in grayscale, depicting its metal texture and providing a sense of depth; the object has two looped handles converging at a pivot point, which separates into two straight, slightly flattened arms ending in a pointed blade-like tip. Three cylindrical posts protrude from the lower edges of the handles, suggesting that they function as supports or legs. Above this, in the top center portion of the drawing, there are two additional diagrams: one is a flat, side-profile view presented in a simple outline style, which clarifies the shape and structure of the tool, and the other is a minimalistic front elevation located just below the profile view. Beneath these diagrams is a linear scale for measurement, and in the lower right corner of the page, the name "Neva Coffey" is written. The background is an off-white or light beige color, and the overall composition is orderly, with the primary illustration at the bottom and the technical outlines and scale centered above it.
title: Flat Iron Holder
